title: Do not deserialize untrusted object formats
summary: Object deserialization formats can invoke behavior or create unsafe state, so untrusted input must use constrained data formats and schemas.
review_checks: Find unsafe object deserializers applied to request, cache, queue, or file data.
Verify authenticity and strict schemas where serialized data cannot be avoided.
safe_tests: Use local synthetic serialized fixtures only.
Confirm malformed data is rejected without invoking application-defined behavior.
remediation: Use data-only formats with strict schemas.
Authenticate serialized data and avoid deserializing objects from untrusted sources.
